Name: Better Artisan Goods 1.6 Additions
Author: Chocoronron
Description:
This mod is inspired by Cometkins's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods[/url] mod, which has not been updated ever since the 1.5 update. To fix the issues caused by the 1.6 update, this mod adds color masks to jellies, pickles, juices, and wines so that their colors change properly in accordance to the crop used. Furthermore, the sprite for the juice is flipped so that it's easier to tell apart from the wine sprite.

Outside of those fixes, the mod also adds sprites for raisins, dried fruits, and dried mushrooms, which are all done in Cometkins's style. Other than artisan goods, the mod retextures the sprites for sugar, wheat flour, rice, vinegar, moss, mossy seeds, mystic syrup, mystic tree seeds, and the two grass starters. Also, a sprite for stardrop tea has been added as well. 

With exception to the kitchen ingredients, moss, and seeds, all of the sprites in this mod are edited versions of Cometkins's existing assets or the vanilla sprites. This is so that the sprites look as close as possible to Cometkins's style.

This mod is completely configurable, so you can decide which retextured sprites you want to see. 

Please report any errors, and I'll try to fix them as soon as possible.
